name: Elektor Audio DAC 2000 (original build: OPA627 I/V, no SRC)
notes: T. Giesberts, Elektor Electronics 11/99, 12/99, 1/2000. CS8414 -> DF1704 8x -> PCM1704 -> OPA627 I/V (2k49 || 47p) -> 3rd-order passive filter (Butterworth 26 kHz; Bessel 42 kHz at 88.2/96, relay-selected from the receiver's rate detection) -> OPA627 buffer -> 100 Ohm -> mute relay. Audio Precision figures from part 3.
zout: 100 Ohm (R40/R42); much higher, or spread between repeats, = relay contact resistance
imd: SMPTE 60 Hz/7 kHz at 0 dB: 0.0035% (-89.1 dB)
xtalk: > 115 dB at 1 kHz, > 88 dB at 20 kHz (with the screen between channels fitted)
